coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across market/competitive landscape for UX teardowns of RAG and agent-builder platforms (Flowise, Langflow, Dify, Gumloop, Coze). Coverage spans: (1) T0 primary captures—official product pages, pricing, documentation, GitHub repositories with 12M-138K stars; (2) T1 official docs and release notes; (3) T2 analyst reports (Gartner Emerging Market Quadrant for No-Code Agent Builders, market sizing from Mordor/Fortune/Persistence), enterprise adoption surveys (Google Cloud 70% production adoption, Gartner 40% pilot-cancellation risk); (4) T3 practitioner teardowns (Medium, Dev.to, vendor blogs, comparison matrices). Dedup: consolidated 40+ candidate sources by removing exact duplicates while retaining distinct analyses (Elestio production-readiness, ZenML Langflow alternatives, IRIS Low-Code platform review). Key angles captured: agent-vs-chat UX confusion (Agentic Design Patterns, Luke Wroblewski), workflow canvas scalability (React Flow, Workflow Builder UX), visual debugging for RAG (RAGExplorer academic system), enterprise governance gaps (Gartner: 21% mature governance, 88% pilot failures), integration breadth (LangChain ecosystem, 50+ Dify tools), and funding signals (Gumloop $24.6M Series A, Flowise Y Combinator). Notable gaps: G2/Capterra lack critical mass for these open-source platforms; Chinese market Coze data limited to press releases; detailed heatmap/session recording data unavailable; academic HCI studies on node/edge editors sparse but captured (Springer, arXiv). Geographic coverage: primarily US/Western analyst perspectives; limited Dify enterprise case studies from Fortune 500s. Total 38 sources across T0-T3.
